column1: # Shared scrubber fixture: ONE list of cases that the Python scrubber (core/audit.py scrub_url_credentials, used by core/logscrub.py), the
# PowerShell copy in scripts/collect-diagnostics.ps1 and the awk copy in scripts/collect-diagnostics.sh must all satisfy.
# Columns, separated by ONE TAB: name, known values (joined by "|", or "-" for none), input, expected output. The known column has no escapes.
# Escapes in input and expected, decoded in ONE left-to-right pass: \t is a tab, \r is a carriage return, \\ is one backslash;
# "(empty)" stands for the empty string. Lines starting with # are comments. The file is UTF-8; read it as UTF-8 explicitly.
# The rules (see scrub_url_credentials): every known value of 4 or more characters, and the part after the first ":" of each (when it is 4
# or more characters), becomes [hidden], literally (never as a pattern) and case-sensitively, longest first and equal lengths in
# character order; then, in every run of non-whitespace text, everything from the first "://" to the last "@" becomes "://[hidden]@"
# (only when an "@" follows the "://" in that run). A run that holds two URLs, or an e-mail address after a URL, is over-masked: that is the
# safe direction and part of the contract. Whitespace is ASCII only (space, tab, CR, LF, VT, FF): a no-break space inside a run does not split it.
